Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

We thank you for your counter-offer and value the opportunity to develop our business relationship. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €6.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Extending payment terms to 90 days substantially increases our financing costs, so we must return to our standard 30 days net. To move towards your target, we can offer a revised price of €6.00 per unit based on these 30-day terms. Specifically, our standard terms option provides a price of €6.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, no Preisgleitklausel.

Please note that our offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to working with you.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.
Our terms: a price of €6.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 12 months, no Preisgleitklausel.
Here is the background.
We note that your proposed price and terms remain unchanged from your previous communication.
As we have already demonstrated flexibility in our previous offer, we are unable to make further concessions without a corresponding step from your side.
We kindly ask you to review your position so that we may progress in these negotiations.
Our conditions follow our Preisliste and discount tiers.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
